# Brambly

> Brambly is a growth app for solo founders that finds what’s holding your product back, helps you clear it, and measures what happens next.

Brambly is in invite-only beta and is free while in beta. It never posts, sends or publishes anything for you. Numbers are labeled measured, estimated, benchmark or sample, and AI-written content is labeled.

Last updated: 2026-10-27

AI search visibility is built to check ChatGPT, Perplexity and Claude; engines are connected one by one during the beta, so some may show as not connected.

## Live today

- [Finding conversations](https://growloop-mcads.lovable.app/features#conversations): Find public Hacker News posts with transparent rule-based scores and reply drafts you post yourself.
- [Conversion leak finder](https://growloop-mcads.lovable.app/features#conversion): See where visitors leave your funnel before you spend on more traffic.
- [Page audit by address](https://growloop-mcads.lovable.app/features#audit): Get an AI-written second look at the copy behind a conversion leak.
- [Technical audit](https://growloop-mcads.lovable.app/features#technical): Check whether Google and AI assistants can find, read and understand your site.
- [Website tracking](https://growloop-mcads.lovable.app/features#tracking): Measure real visits and signups with one script line.
- [AI search visibility](https://growloop-mcads.lovable.app/features#visibility): See how often connected AI assistants recommend you beside your competitors; engines are connected one by one during the beta.
- [Product profile](https://growloop-mcads.lovable.app/features#profile): Put your product, audience and buyer questions in one editable place.
- [Multi-product workspace](https://growloop-mcads.lovable.app/features#workspace): Keep up to 3 products together, with separate numbers for each.

- [Competitor gaps](https://growloop-mcads.lovable.app/features#coming-next): Soon, not available yet. Find opportunities your competitors are missing.
